notes: How each fixed refusal message in the matching literals file is shown (Decision 22). "text" replaces a message that read like a developer note with a plain sentence; "code" gives it a reason code and so the catalog sentence, with an optional field; "keep" lists messages reviewed and fine as written; "unreviewed" lists messages not yet reviewed, shown as written. Every literal is in exactly one; the number unreviewed is capped in tools/refusal_unreviewed_maximums.json and can only fall.
